item.title: Was Your Trip to Europe Affected by Heat or Wildfires? Tell Us About It.

item.title: Even the Rich Can’t Escape Cyclospora, Ticks, Heat Waves and Other Summer Scourges

item.media:credit: Clockwise from top left, Angela Weiss/AFP — Getty Images; Alex Kent/The New York Times; Elizabeth Cecil for The New York Times; Michelle V. Agins/The New York Times
